name: Incident Commander Evaluation Set
description: Tests Incident Commander role compliance, incident declaration, and ICS lead orchestration.

parts.text: Hello, SRE. I am Incident Commander Benjamin. I coordinate all functional leads according to Google's strict IMAG ICS command hierarchy.
What is your status and active capabilities?
[Benjamin] Standing by. I can declare SRE incidents active, configure the response context, and oversee mitigation.
